run.notes: Path S1-P3 (capability template). User text appended after the injected template.

steps.notes: Greeting 'Ready when you are.', composer 'Ask ChatGPT', Think toggle, voice. Three capability entries below: Create an image or sticker, Write or edit, Search the web. No example prompts.

problems.what_happened: The capability entries are generic categories; nothing in the empty state mentions writing an email, so Kim must infer that 'Write or edit' covers the task.

steps.notes: Hover on 'Write or edit' shows a dismiss x. Selecting it opens the submenu (03-submenu); placeholder becomes 'Write anything'.

problems.what_happened: No submenu entry matches the email task (Summarize a passage / Rewrite for clarity / Polish a message); Kim has to pick a near-match that is about rewriting existing text, not writing a new email.
The entry labels do not say that selecting one inserts an instruction into the composer; the consequence is only visible after the click.
problems.notes: Consequence if Kim takes the nearest entry ('Rewrite for clarity'): the inserted instruction asks to rewrite 'my text' while Kim's text is a request to write a new email, so the combined prompt contradicts itself (05-prompt-filled.png).

steps.notes: Submenu: Summarize a passage, Rewrite for clarity, Polish a message. None is about writing a new email; 'Rewrite for clarity' was selected as the closest.
